Description: Offshore Channel

Name: CorPower Ocean
Description: CorPower Ocean designs, manufactures and operates wave energy farms for our customers. The wave farm solution have a unique design inspired by the pumping principles of the human heart, allowing it to survive the toughest storms. Advanced control technology makes the wave energy converters oscillate in optimal timing with incoming waves, strongly amplifying power absorption. This enables high power output compared to the size, weight and cost of the equipment  The combination of low costs, high capacity factor and an effective maintenance scheme makes wave power a key tool to accelerate the transition to 100% renewables around the world

Name: Epishine
Description: Epishine is a Swedish energy impact company, reimagining the capture of light with market leading printed organic solar cells. Our technology captures indoor light to make electronics self-powered, making cables, disposable batteries and unnecessary maintenance a thing of the past.

Name: Absolicon Solar Collector AB
Description:
At Absolicon, we are committed to the transition to renewable heat and
envision a sustainable industry.
Absolicon is a listed Swedish solar energy company specialized in concentrated solar heating. We help industries change from fossil fuels using solar thermal resources. Absolicon industrial heating solutions reduce the existing fuel cost, prevent CO2 emissions, and ensure energy security for industries.
Our collector, the T160 has the highest optical efficiency ever measured for a commercially available small parabolic trough. The industrial thermal solar collector can help reduce the production costs and produce heat and steam up to temperatures of 160oC.
Together with the solar collector, Absolicon has developed a complete production line for our T160, with the capacity to produce one solar collector every 6 minutes.

Name: SunRoof
Description:
SunRoof is revolutionizing home electrification and decentralized renewable energy generation with the most powerful and resource-efficient 2-in-1 solar roofs on the market. 
Our solutions seamlessly combine exceptional functionality with an aesthetic design that both pleases and impresses customers. 
Serving private homes, developers, commercial buildings, and public structures, SunRoof is at the forefront of delivering sustainable energy solutions. 
We are proud to lead the way toward a greener, more energy-efficient future.

Name: Midsummer
Description:
Midsummer is a leading European manufacturer of in thin film solar panels. Our innovative products provide a range of rooftop solutions that are not only lightweight and flexible but also aesthetically pleasing. With a commitment to sustainability, our panels boast a 90% reduction in environmental impact compared to traditional silicon solar panels. 

Our partners are mainly leading European construction, roofing and solar cell installation companies but we also sell and install solar roofs directly to end customers. Midsummer also develops and sells equipment for the production of flexible thin film solar cells to strategically selected partners and machinery for research. 

The solar cells are of CIGS technology (consist of copper, indium, gallium and selenide) and are thin, light, flexible, discreet and with a minimal carbon footprint compared with other solar panels.

The solar cells are produced using the company’s own unique DUO system which has taken the position as the most widespread manufacturing tool for flexible CIGS solar cells in the world. 

The company’s shares (MIDS) are traded on Nasdaq First North Growth Market.

Name: Monsson
Description:
Bringing a wind farm to life is a laborious and time-consuming process, involving a great amount of resources. Established in 1997, Monsson Group has focused on renewable energy since 2004 and became a major wind farm developer country wide with more than 2400 MW projects in its portfolio.

Driven by the hard work of more than 500 specialized employees, Monsson Group performs a wide range of services for wind farms comprising development, construction, operation, maintenance, service and electricity trading.

Energy demand is on a constant rise due to increasing population and further industrialization, at the same time fossil fuel reserves are diminishing. The pressing global demand of finding solutions for the climate change is today’s problem that will influence tomorrow. Through the forces of Nature we are enabled to have a security of supply and a sustainable electricity generation, thus we see Nature as the only solution for today’s energy problem.

Starting 2014, Monsson Group began the expansion world wide, and has now offices in Stockholm, Bucharest, Warsaw, Istambul, Qatar, Cape Town and New Zealand.

Name: Senergia AB
Description: Senergia is a partner for installers in solar energy, electric car charging and energy storage. We offer products for safe and fast delivery from leading manufacturers. Senergia also drives market-leading skills development through training and certifications for the industry. From ordering and technical support to safe and fast delivery, Senergia is a reliable partner.

Name: Cleantech Scandinavia
Description:
Cleantech Scandinavia is the leading Nordic cleantech investor network. The company runs an internationally established network of investors, industrials and public actors, all with an interest in Nordic Cleantech. We are a trusted source of cleantech-related investment opportunities, business intelligence, investment statistics and we are a renowned provider and promoter of Nordic Cleantech. Today we have some 70 members including venture funds, industrial ventures from leading multinational companies, corporates, real estate companies, cities and government organisations. We have members from Scandinavia, Continental Europe, China, North America and other locations.

www.cleantechscandinavia.com
www.nordiccleantechopen.com
www.nordiccleantechaccelerator.com

Follow us on twitter 
CTScandinavia

Name: novotegra
Description:
We are novotegra: Manufacturer of our mounting system specially developed for photovoltaic installations

Our systems are compatible with all common roof types and are characterised by high flexibility, reliability and top quality. Installers who build photovoltaic systems are supported with personal advice and a comprehensive range of further training. 

novotegra has been operating independently as a company since 2021. All products are sold in Europe exclusively through BayWa r.e.’s wholesale business.

Name: Rivus Batteries
Description:
Rivus Batteries offers truly green batteries for stationary energy storage applications through organic flow batteries. 

Rivus technology is already proven on a small scale, currently looking for pilot-customers interested in testing and pioneering sustainable stationary energy storage solutions in the size of 100 - 500 kWh.

Name: Plagazi
Description:
The Plagazi  process converts all types of waste into circular hydrogen through plasma gasification. The production process is highly energy self-sufficient and environmentally friendly by not producing any dangerous by-products. We work towards a circular economy and for a better future. 

Plagazi is the solution to cost-effective and large-scale circular hydrogen production by treating non-recyclable waste types and is the solution to a reduced carbon footprint. Plagazi's green hydrogen has a very high purity and can be used for everything from fuel cells to industrial processes.

Name: BatteryLoop
Description:
BatteryLoop creates a scalable and circular energy storage system (BLESSTM) made from reused electric vehicle batteries. 

BLESSTM provides the opportunity to store and move energy therefore reducing the power cost, secure power to charging points, analyze and optimize power utilizations via assessments. This enables your organization to mitigate the lack of power created by the electrification of society by the increasing of charging infrastructure and renewable energy. 

Our Offerings & Sectors
We focus on creating opportunities for Real Estate, Logistic centers and Ports, all driven by societal electrification and an increased need for charging. 

We offer a design solution for power supply systems that can respond immediately to an increase in demand. With knowledge of the total energy system BatteryLoops positioning is strong because we are able to deliver power at the right time to support the customer requirement.

History
We are a new company and we see our future as an extension of our past, dating back to 1939 as part of Stena.

Follow us and visit our website for more information on how we can support your business towards net-zero emissions.

Name: Connected Wind Services Group
Description:
Connected Wind Services is Europe’s strongest independent service provider for wind turbines. For more than 25 years, our multi-brand, multi-skill approach, combined with local competencies, has been the foundation for providing wind turbine operators and owners with unrivalled reliability and service.

We adapt to individual needs and are focused on the full lifecycle of wind turbines. Our reputation is built on efficiency, flexibility and safety within wind turbine Service Maintenance, Service Projects and retail of Components & Spare Parts. We deliver integrated, high-value services that help maximize yield and protect assets - providing all you need from a single point of contact.

Name: Eways
Description:
Vi gör det lätt att köra elbil!

EWAYS är den ledande oberoende laddoperatören i Sverige som gör det lätt att köra elbil. Vi erbjuder laddinstallationer för enkel, snabb och säker laddning hemma, vid arbetsplatsen och publikt.

Vi hjälper våra kunder genom hela processen från idén om att kunna ladda bilar, till driftsättning och övervakning av laddstationer samt slutligen nedmontering och återvinning. Vi erbjuder även en mängd innovativa molntjänster för övervakning, statistik, lastbalansering och betalningslösningar.

Vi arbetar med samhällets klimatomställning från fossila bilar till elbilar. Våra kunder är såväl privatpersoner och bostadsrättsföreningar som fastighetsägare, fastighetsförvaltare, företag, städer och kommuner.

Vi är intresserade av allt som påskyndar konverteringen från fossila bilar till elbilar. Kontakta oss gärna om du behöver hjälp med elbilsladdning, har idéer eller bara vill heja på mot ett mer hållbart bilkörande. Tillsammans gör vi det lätt att köra elbil!

Name: Sunna Group
Description:
Sunna was founded in 2021 with the ambition to increase the amount of solar power in the energy system by developing, owning and managing large-scale solar power in the Nordic region. Together with long-term capital partners, Sunna is a sustainable player in the Swedish energy market.

We add value to low-productivity land and increase access to green, locally produced solar electricity, enabling faster regional establishment and expansion of businesses, as well as supporting the electrification of society at large. Our goal is to build 1 gigawatt by 2030.

For more information, visit sunnagroup.com/en.

Name: Kedali Sweden AB
Description:
Kedali Sweden AB is subsidiary of Kedali Industry Co., Ltd, Is the world’s largest manufacturer of casings for lithium-ion batteries.

Kedali is principally engaged in research and development, manufacture and sales of lithium battery precision components and automotive components. The Company's main products include power and energy storage lithium battery precision components, portable lithium battery precision components and automotive components. Its products are mainly applied in the fields of automobiles and new energy automobiles, portable communications and electronics, electric tools, and energy storage power stations.

Name: Evolar AB
Description:
In May 2023, Evolar AB was acquired by First Solar, a leading American solar technology company and global provider of responsibly produced eco-efficient solar modules advancing the fight against climate change. The laboratory in Uppsala, Sweden, continues to conduct its research and development activity under the new name.

For more information about First Solar:
- Visit us on the web at http://www.firstsolar.com
- Follow us on Twitter at http://www.twitter.com/firstsolar (@FirstSolar)
- Check us out on YouTube at http://www.youtube.com/firstsolar

Name: LUMA Energy
Description: Vi hjälper fastighetsägare och deras hyresgäster att minska kostnader, öka intäkter och sina möjligheter till grön certifiering genom förnybar el. Vår lösning gör fastigheterna till aktiva spelare på energimarknaden och kapten över resan mot en lönsam och grön elaffär. Välkommen till elrevolutionen, där solceller, energilager och laddinfrastruktur samlas i en oberoende mjukvaruplattform, LUMA-portalen.

Name: ECOKRAFT Sverige
Description:
ECOKRAFT erbjuder solceller för din egen elproduktion sedan 2008. Vi projekterar och installerar kompletta solcellssystem, batterilagringslösningar och laddinfrastruktur för villa, lantbruk och företag och jobbar med marknadsledande komponenter av högsta kvalitet. Genom åren har vi samlat på oss massor av referenser och vi strävar alltid efter att leverera en helhetsupplevelse med kunden i fokus.

Vi jobbar för att på ett smidigt, enkelt och professionellt sätt hjälpa privatpersoner och företag att producera sin egen el och erbjuder därför allt från planering och projektering till installation och driftsättning. Vårt stora kunnande, noggrannhet och fokus på kunden har lett till att allt fler väljer ECOKRAFT. Kvalitet och kundnöjdhet är våra ledord som genomsyrar hela verksamheten. 

ECOKRAFT - Sveriges tryggaste solcellsleverantör.

Name: Sweden Sustaintech Venture Day
Description: Sweden Sustaintech Venture Day is the leading Swedish capital market day for scale-up sustaintech companies to meet Swedish and international investors. The event will be on October 9th-10th #ssvd24 #sustainableinvestments #venturecapital #impact #swedensustaintech24

Name: GOSOL ENERGI AB
Description:
GoSol Energi AB bedriver verksamhet inom solenergi och hållbara energisystem. Verksamheten omfattar projektledning, projektering, installation samt handel med energiteknik. Vi samarbetar med flera välkända och etablerade tillverkare, grossister och leverantörer.

Besök vår hemsida på www.gosol.se

Name: Scandinavian Society for Trenchless Technology - SSTT
Description:
SSTT webbplats är ett öppet forum och mötesplats för diskussion, utbyte av erfarenheter, informationsspridning och utveckling av schaktfri teknik. Medlemmarna är alla aktörer inom schaktfritt ledningsbyggande (NoDig-metoder), t.ex. ledningsägare leverantörer, entreprenörer och konsulter.

SSTT bidrar därmed till en positiv och hållbar samhällsutveckling och ett minimum av miljöpåverkan och resursanvändning när det gäller expansion, underhåll och förnyelse av samhällets tekniska infrastruktur.

Name: Krannich Solar Sverige
Description:
Krannich Solar is one of the leading photovoltaic distributors worldwide. The owner-managed and self-financed company offers a wide range of products for PV installers: solar modules, inverters, photovoltaic mounting systems, self-consumption systems, e-mobility, pv installation monitoring and accessories.

 

Krannich Solar is represented by more than 25 countries worldwide and employs  850 people. The headquarters is situated in Weil der Stadt, near Stuttgart, Germany.

 

Krannich Solar attaches great importance to providing its customers and project partners with sound advice and high product quality. Only high-quality components are included in the photovoltaic wholesaler's product range. The portfolio includes solar modules from the following manufacturers: Axitec, LG, Luxor, Panasonic, REC, Suntech and many more. Brands for the areas of inverters, optimization, storage solutions and e-mobility: ABB, AEConversion, Axitec, BYD, Delta, Enphase, Fronius, Kaco, Kostal, LG Chem, Mennekes, SMA, SolarEdge, Solax Power, and many more. Mounting systems are supplied by IRFTS, K2 Systems, Mazari, Renusol, ZEP, and many others. Thanks to effective logistics, the ordered goods reach their destination as quickly as possible.

 

All this makes Krannich Solar a professional partner for PV installers. For each customer and each project, from family homes to solar parks. The trained sales and technical team will be happy to answer all your questions about the topic of photovoltaics.

 

Get to know us and see for yourself that we are the right partner for you! Call us, write us an e-mail or visit us at our office. We are looking forward to working with you.

Name: myFC AB
Description:
myFC is a Swedish innovation company focusing on green and sustainable technology. The company was founded in 2005 as a spin-off from fuel cell research at KTH, the Royal Institute of Technology in Stockholm. We are a technology solution provider that offers thin, modular, and scalable PEM fuel cells that are easy to adapt to electrical applications, focusing on a power range from 1 W to 3kW rated power.

myFC is a world leader in micro fuel cell technology, where its own, patented fuel cells provide the highest possible energy density per volume and area. The hybrid solution we have developed combines accumulators, such as batteries, with hydrogen-based micro fuel cells and provides a maximum operating time without any emissions other than pure water.

Name: INNOVENTUM
Description:
INNOVENTUM is a provider of carbon-neutral and innovative small wind turbine, hybrid and solar power solutions.

To offer environmentally friendly products with the lowest carbon impact possible, INNOVENTUM sells towers and structures made of wood instead of steel. Our unique designs comprise the most innovative technologies in wood engineering, our passion for sustainable development, and are inspired by famous pieces of art and architectural landmarks. They will be an eyecatcher in each of our customer’s gardens as well as in public areas.

With an innovative approach in all business areas, INNOVENTUM stands out from the crowd and sets new standards in innovation leadership in the renewable energy industry.

Name: Sticky Solar Power
Description:
Sticky Solar Power is a Swedish developer and supplier of innovative solar photovoltaic technology solutions. 

The Tape SolutionTM is a novel interconnection and string production technology that enables competitive and high-efficiency solar PV manufacturing in Europe and beyond.

Name: Bee Charging Solutions
Description: We offer high-performance charging solutions designed for you, not your car. Bee offers creative mobility for a new era. Join us on our journey and be part of a positive movement.

Name: Solifokus
Description:
Solifokus är ett innovativt solcellsföretag som erbjuder smidiga och kostnadseffektiva helhetslösningar för privatpersoner och företag som vill investera i solceller, laddboxar eller solcellsbatterier. 

Vi är stolta medlemmar i Svensk Solenergi och har höga kvalitetskrav på våra produkter och tjänster. Vår vision är att bidra till en grönare framtid genom att främja användningen av förnybar energi.

Name: renbloc
Description:
RenBloc are set to disrupt the central core of the energy market.

Renbloc is a comprehensive and transparent solution for tracing and verifying sources of energy. Suppliers and customers can easily keep track of when, where and how their energy is produced. We see a future where awareness in the energy market increases, and the power of consumer choice takes central stage in everyday life.

We want to increase the transparency in the energy market by giving consumers the opportunity to freely choose the origin of their energy, bringing purchasing power the energy market

RenBloc brings purchasing power the energy market. The conscious consumer will for the first time be able voice their energy opinion by directly and transparently choose the origin of their energy. 

We see this free will as a major step in the development of global democracy.

Name: Waves4Power AB
Description:
Generating power from ocean Waves. Power that never ends.
Waves4Power creates a better future through green energy solutions. Living on this planet and being part of human society comes with responsibilities. Waves4Power improves lives and betters the environment by developing and selling innovative renewable ocean energy systems.
Location: 422 44 Hisings Backa, Västra Götalands Län, Sweden

Name: CC90 Composite AB
Description:
CC90 Composite is a Swedish company that is active in the European solar energy market.
We offer the installer our easy-to-use mounting system for solar panels where rails and components are made of composite. To obtain a durable, safe and easy installation so several of the components are mounted with a click function only.

We want it to be easy and profitable to install solar panels.

Name: Saxlund Group
Description:
Engineered solutions for clean energy, clean air and clean water.

Saxlund is a green tech company that focuses on helping our clients to reduce their impact on the world's environment. We deliver systems and solutions to our clients that help reduce the usage of fossil fuels.

Name: Nysäter Wind
Description: Nysäter Wind AB owns and operates one of Sweden's largest operating wind clusters. Located in the area of Härnösand, Sweden, the project is divided into two wind farms with 114 turbines in total, 3 substations and a power output of 475 MW. Nysäter Wind produces c. 1.7 TWh of electricity per annum making the project a fundamental pillar of Sweden's strategic transformation to an energy transition hub. The 114 wind turbines can supply the equivalent consumption of over 300,000 households with renewable electricity.

Name: Opigo AB
Description:
Opigo är en av Sveriges största oberoende laddoperatörer inom elbilsladdning.

Vi hjälper våra kunder med hela processen, från projektering och behovsanalys till installation, betaltjänster och övervakning. Våra kunder har alltid en nära personlig kontakt med oss genom hela projektets gång, och våra kunder är främst bostadsrättsföreningar, fastighetsägare, företag och andra samarbetspartners.

Med vår egenutvecklade mjukvara och betaltjänst EVcore är vi med och driver utvecklingen av elbilsladdningen i Sverige. EVcore appen är nedladdningsbar via App Store och Google Play.

Vi är verksamma i hela Sverige och har idag kontor i Stockholm, Göteborg, Lund, Norrköping och Enköping.

Hur kan vi hjälpa Er?

Name: SMA Solar Sverige
Description:
Innovativa och hållbara nyckelteknologier är förutsättningar för förnybar energiförsörjning!

Över 4000 anställda från 20 länder arbetar för att säkerställa att SMA aktivt hjälper till att främja produktion och utveckling av solcellsanläggningsteknik globalt. 
Vi erbjuder rätt växelriktare för alla solpanelsmodeller och systemstorlekar; till villalösningar, mellanstora system för näringsidkare och solcellsparker; nätanslutna solcellsanläggningar, off-grid- och hybridsystem. 

SMA ligger i framkant när det gäller framtidens energi inom områden såsom intelligent optimering av egenförbrukning, nätintegrering för solel och tillägg av batterier för effektivare användning av förnybar energi. 

Vi vill därför dela med oss expertkunskaper inom växelriktarteknik, intressanta referensprojekt och nya produkter inom området kommersiella och storskaliga solkraftverk samt diskutera dagens och framtida energiförsörjningsstrukturer och lösningar. 

Vi ser fram emot kommentarer, frågor och feedback!

Information om företaget: https://www.sma.de/en/corporate-information.html 

Personuppgiftsskydd: https://www.sma-sweden.com/data-protection-declaration.html

#solenergi #solcellsanläggning #växelriktare #laddstolpar #laddbox #evcharger #energieffektivisering #energimanagement #smasverige

Name: ATS-Orwak
Description:
ATS-Orwak är en ledande aktör inom hållbar avfallshanteringsteknik, specialiserad på effektiva komprimeringslösningar.

Med huvudkontor i Bromma och lokala kontor i hela Sverige erbjuder vi skräddarsydda lösningar som hjälper våra kunder att minska sina transportkostnader och tömningar av avfall. Vi levererar högkvalitativa maskiner, inklusive avfallskomprimatorer, balpressar och rullkrossar, som effektivt minskar volymen av avfall, sopor och restprodukter.

Vår serviceorganisation står alltid redo att erbjuda snabb och pålitlig support för att säkerställa att våra kunder får maximal nytta av sina investeringar. Vi strävar efter hög kundnöjdhet genom att leverera både produkter och service av högsta kvalitet.

För att ytterligare optimera våra kunders verksamhet erbjuder vi lösningar för utomhuslagring av avfall i snygga, brandsäkra containrar. Detta frigör värdefull inomhusyta och ger ett kostnadseffektivt sätt att hantera avfallet.

Vårt engagemang för hållbarhet, kvalitet och effektivitet gör ATS-Orwak till en självklar partner för företag som vill minska sina avfallskostnader, öka produktiviteten och bidra till en mer cirkulär ekonomi.

Name: Renetech AB
Description:
Renetech was incorporated in the spring of 2005.With a global perspective, it is Renetech's mission to be a sustainable and environmentally adapted producer of vehicle fuel, electricity, heat and biogas through solutions for waste and biomass management and energy efficiency. Renetech develops bioenergy projects in collaboration with technology providers, contractors, equity partners and local stakeholders.

Renetech’s primary market segment is the production of vehicle fuels by means of processing of biomass. Renetech focuses on the process, project and financing of the plant build of Anaerobic Digester plants, Bio-refineries and CHP plants.

Renetech use proven and efficient technical solutions leveraging upon the knowledge base and existing implementations in the Nordic markets. Renetech has a strong business association with technology partners who bring deep and broad experience of the renewable energy sector.

Name: Algorithm Energy AB
Description:
Algorithm Energy APM acquires real time events, alarms, states and parameters from turbines and sub-station Scada systems. 

Its algorithms sift through this raw data and transform it into a cohesive and meaningful flow of information that is full of fresh insights for the owners of the wind farms. 

For technical teams, the APM generates calls for specific actions. These are both corrective and preventive in nature. When followed through, these actions reduce production losses.

Name: O2O RENEWABLES
Description:
The goal of O2O RENEWABLES is to create an efficient collaboration between renewable asset owners to increase transparency in the renewable industry and make renewables even more competitive. 

At O2O WIND International, wind asset owner employees share knowledge and experience within Operations and Maintenance  to create a common platform of best practice.

O2O WIND International is founded by Statoil, RWE Innogy, Acciona Energia, Skellefteå Kraft, EDF Luminus, Vattenfall Wind Power and Gas Natural Fenosa Renovables. 

All wind asset owners active at O2O WIND own among themselves closer to 18 % of all the turbines in the world.

Name: Enersize
Description:
Enersize is a green high tech company specializing in software and know-how for reducing energy consumption and CO2 emissions in compressed air systems by 30-50%. These systems account for close to 2% of total global electricity usage, which in turn cause annual carbon dioxide emissions equivalent to 80 million cars.

During 2019 Enersize has expanded its product portfolio and is now focusing on growth in EU and Asia.

Name: KOSTAL Solar Electric Scandinavia
Description:
Som KOSTAL Solar Electric GmbH är vi en ledande leverantör av innovativa hybrid- och solomriktare för privata och kommersiella solenergisystem, samt för lösningar inom elfordon. Som en lösningsskapare för intelligent energiproduktion och användning samarbetar vi nära med olika teknikpartners för framgångsrik sektorankoppling och energilagring.

Förutom innovativa omriktare inkluderar KOSTAL Solar Electrics produktportfölj också den egna KOSTAL Wallbox, energimätare och lämplig övervakningsprogramvara.

Våra lösningar för framtidens energi utvecklas och produceras i Tyskland och uppfyller högsta kvalitetsstandarder. Vi drar nytta av KOSTAL Groups över 100 års erfarenhet som fordonsleverantör.

Name: Biogas Öst
Description:
Biogas Öst är ett storregionalt nätverk som genom samverkan mellan olika aktörer ska påverka och förbättra förutsättningarna för biogas i regionen och bidra till att berörda miljömål uppnås. Biogas Öst verkar i en region som omfattar Uppsala, Västmanland, Södermanland, Örebro, Stockholm och Östergötlands län.

Genom att samordna resurser, kompetenser och goda initiativ kan vi uppnå de bästa resultaten. Biogas Östs verksamhet fokuseras i första hand på:

 ATT överbrygga hinder för biogasens utveckling och verka för de bästa regionala förutsättningarna för ökad produktion, distribution och konsumtion av biogas.

 ATT verka för att stärka lokal och regional samverkan och utgöra en kunskaps- och kommunikationsresurs för regionen och dess aktörer.

 ATT främja utvecklingsprojekt som leder till bättre miljö, en hållbar tillväxt samt regional utveckling.

Över 40 aktörer i hela biogaskedjan är medlemmar i Biogas Öst. Välkommen att följa med oss på denna resa!

Biogas Öst drivs av den storregionala samverkansorganisationen BioDriv Öst.

Name: JS Energi
Description:
JS Energi is the leading spare part supplier for heat pumps and heating units in Europe. Through our local sites jsenergi.com, jsenergi.co.uk, jsenergi.dk and jsenergi.eu we make 120000 spare parts available for B2C and B2B customers all over Europe. 

We do also in Sweden offer new heat pump installations, commissioning, service and maintenance of heat pumps. 

As a partner to nearly all heat pump manufacturers we offer a wide range of parts, accessories as well as services connected to the parts. 

Since the funding in 1997 we have installed over 4000 heat pumps in the southern parts of Sweden and deliverd over 100 000 original spare parts all over Europe.

Name: Axjo Recycling AB (tidigare Drumster Sverige AB)
Description: Upptäck Drumster! En apptjänst utöver det vanliga. Ett miljövänligt och enkelt sätt för hantering av kabeltrummor.

Name: WIN Water
Description: WIN Water is a business network that facilitates faster market access to innovative water-related products and services. Founded in January 2012, the WIN network consists of small innovative companies as well as large corporations and other organizations such as universities and municipalities.

Name: Lidköping Energi
Description: Lidköping Energi är ett modernt och hållbart energibolag, med professionella och engagerade anställda. På uppdrag av kommunen förser vi vår stad med driftsäker och klimatsmart fjärrvärme som framställs av avfallsprodukter, ett smart sätt att tillvarata en restprodukt som annars inte skulle komma till nytta. Strävan att bidra till ett hållbart samhälle och skapa ett kostnadseffektivt och uthålligt energisystem genomsyrar hela bolaget. Vi känner ett stort ansvar för det samhälle vi verkar och lever i, för Lidköping och är stolta över att vi bidrar till att göra Lidköping till en mer hållbar stad.

Name: Team Safety - Teambyggarna, Teamsolar
Description:

Name: Saturn EIT Climate-KIC
Description:
- SATURN - 
System and sustainable Approach to virTuous interaction
of Urban and Rural LaNdscapes

VISION 

Today, the fragmented landscape management governance leads to uncompleted climate strategies where cities are analysed independently from their natural landscape. This leads to a bad management of the city surrounding lands which have good carbon sequestration, food and biomass production and risk mitigation potential. This project is based on the experience of 3 cities forming the consortium: Trento (Italy), Birmingham (UK) and Gothenburg (Sweden) and it aims to reintegrate the natural assets within the city climate change impact strategy and to expand and feed its model by creating a wider initiative.

MISSION

The objectives of the projects are threefold:

> Establish  a strong narrative with public and private stakeholders in order to reconnect them with their landscape identity and geographical (urban, rural, regional, territorial) characteristics. The project will involve more than 50 stakeholders coming from different sectors and territories;
> Build up a comprehensive and flexible framework to guide cities to implement adapted projects about multi-functional use at different scale on the land surrounding the cities, taking into account land use assets and the cultural identity in their surrounding landscape. It will include tools and metrics to support decision making;
> Make the initiative economically sustainable and scalable through scouting actions of funding and collaboration opportunities and the creation of comprehensive tools and initiatives for capacity building.

Name: KSRR - Kalmarsundsregionens Renhållare
Description:
Kalmarsundsregionens Renhållare (KSRR) är ett kommunalförbund som ansvarar för renhållning och avfallshantering i våra fem medlemskommuner Kalmar, Oskarshamn, Nybro, Torsås och Mörbylånga.

KSRR har drygt 80 anställda, varav majoriteten utgörs av chaufförer och renhållningsarbetare på våra återvinningscentraler. Ett 20-tal personer arbetar med administration.

I KSRR:s område bor 138 000 invånare och vi tömmer ungefär 5 000 avfallskärl varje dag. 

Allt hushållsavfall som läggs i det gröna sopkärlet kommer till vår sorteringsanläggning i Moskogen.  De gröna påsarna med matavfall skiljs från restavfallet med hjälp av optiskt sortering. Av matavfallet görs ett substrat som sedan rötas och blir till biogas. Rötresterna som blir kvar används till biogödsel.

Av restavfallet tillverkas ett avfallsbränsle som ersätter fossilt kol i Cementas cementugnar.

Vi har åtta bemannade återvinningscentraler för grovavfall, varav fem, en i varje medlemskommun, har öppet sju dagar i veckan. Det finns även tre obemannade återvinningscentraler som är öppna 08-20 varje dag. 

Vår huvudanläggning stod klar i augusti 2018 och ligger i Moskogen, strax väster om Kalmar. 

Där finns Moskogens Avfallsanläggning, vilken är regionens största avfallsanläggning. Den drivs av KSRR:s dotterbolag Moskogen Miljö AB, som även driver Storskogens Avfallsanläggning i Oskarshamn.

Name: CarbonLock
Description:
CarbonLock is an ecolabel born in 2020 in Sweden.

While our goal is to decrease CO2 emissions, the idea behind CarbonLock is first and foremost to decrease the amount of available CO2 emission rights, and thereby to decrease the industrial emissions.
Our philosophy is that "the best climate compensation is the one that is not needed". We are therefore focusing on making sure to avoid CO2 emissions instead of compensating them.

The other goal is to involve people in society in the initiative.
In order to do that, we are working with businesses and brands (the Partners) who give us a financial participation based on their turnover, which we use in order to buy and freeze CO2 emission rights.
As this forces the heavy industry to produce more sustainably and emit less, we are able to guarantee that every time a product or service is bought, the industrial CO2 emissions are decreasing.

CarbonLock is a strong and innovative initiative, enabling people in society to decrease industrial CO2 emissions, not only at their own level, but also at the highest level, by ensuring that the bigger industry follows their fight for the climate and emits less.

Follow us, find us and join us in saving our planet!

Name: LEMON-DIAL project
Description:
LEMON will provide a new versatile Differential Absorption Lidar (DIAL) sensor concept for greenhouse gases and water vapour measurements from space.

LEMON aims at developing a Lidar emitter for space applications to monitor greenhouse gases and water vapour. LEMON will improve the accuracy of climate change analysis.

After instrument set-up and validation, CO2, CH4, H2O isotopes measurements will be performed through airborne demonstrations.

Roadmaps and preliminary experiments towards space operation will be also developed.

LEMON technology relies on a multispecies Lidar emitter benefiting from versatility, efficiency and increased functionality:
- 1 instrument for CO2, CH4, H2O, HDO measurements => 1 single maturation process towards space.
- Possible simultaneous CO2+H2O or H2O HDO measurements.

The LEMON consortium is composed of 8 partners from 4 different countries.
The consortium includes academic experts and research centres, along with SME partners.
It has full expertise at Earth Observation technologies, from receiver, data acquisition, instrument control and versatile emitter.

Food Shift is an open collective nourishing and connecting people, projects and organisations in emerging regenerative food systems.

Regenerate, recreate, rebuild what has been lost. Create more than we consume. Restore the damage that has been done to earth. Rebuild and regenerate our connection to place, to soil and to each other. Move away from economies of extraction to co-created economies of shared value. Built on trust, community and sense of belonging.

Food Shift wants to accelerate this transition and play a vital role in enabling new ecosystems.

We are currently in the process of setting the foundations to the network. Some pieces are still missing... and probably always will. Feel free to join the discussion.

What do we envision the daily practice of the network will be?
– Networking, for starters. Connecting with people and projects all across the food system
– Strengthening our collective sense making and meaning making
– Exploring, learning, mapping, sharing knowledge
– Nurture ideas and projects
– Real world events - conferences

– Inspiring others: blog, video?, public discussions

... these are early days for Food Shift, let’s build this thing together!

ReLuminus Refillsystem AB lanserar nu ett unikt miljökoncept i kristall anpassat för hotell och restaurang. Eftersom det inte behövs användas engångskoppar av aluminium så medför konceptet stora miljövinster. OptiWatti är en smart lösning som styr fastighetens uppvärmning separat för varje rum baserat på hur och när de används. Med OptiWatti kan man sänka sina uppvärmningskostnader med upp till 40 %. OptiWatti används för att styra uppvärmningen i fastigheter. Tjänsten fungerar utmärkt t.ex. i kontor, produktionslokaler, stugbyar, daghem, och kommunala fastigheter.

OptiWatti styr temperaturen separat för varje rum baserat på när och hur rummet används. Temperaturerna är lätta att justera efter årstid och tid på dygnet samt användningsgrad.

Hållbar eluppvärmning på kort tid

Genom att förbättra fastighetens energieffektivitet minskar man effektivt dess klimatavtryck. Gamla fastigheter uppfyller inte alltid dagens krav: uppvärmningskostnaderna springer lätt iväg, mekanismerna är gammalmodiga och eftersom temperaturerna ställs in manuellt kan de hamna var som helst.

OptiWatti minskar det ekologiska fotavtrycket utan att försämra fastighetens användarkomfort. Det påverkar eluppvärmningens energiförbrukning på ett exakt och effektivt sätt.

Med OptiWatti kan du även hitta nya besparingsobjekt: rumsspecifik rapportering gör det lättare att identifiera energislukare oach värmeläckage i fastigheten och rapporterna fungerar som ”bevismaterial” när du ska utvärdera fastighetens renoveringsbehov.

Name: NanoTech Innovations
Description:
NanoTech Solutions is a cutting-edge nanofabrication company specializing in advanced technological solutions. We harness the power of nanotechnology to develop innovative products and services that address a wide range of industries and applications. Our expertise lies in the precise manipulation and control of matter at the nanoscale, enabling us to create materials, devices, and systems with exceptional precision and functionality.

At NanoTech Solutions, we pride ourselves on pushing the boundaries of what is possible in nanofabrication. Our team of skilled scientists, engineers, and researchers collaborates closely to develop custom solutions tailored to the specific needs of our clients. Whether it's developing nanoscale electronic components or high-performance photonic or biomedical devices, we deliver state-of-the-art solutions that drive technological advancements and offer a competitive edge.

With a strong focus on quality, reliability, and efficiency, NanoTech Solutions ensures that our products and services meet the highest industry standards. We prioritize constant innovation and stay at the forefront of emerging nanotechnologies, ensuring that our clients benefit from the latest advancements in the field.

Partnering with NanoTech Solutions means gaining access to cutting-edge nanofabrication capabilities and a dedicated team of experts who are passionate about pushing the limits of what nanotechnology can achieve. Together, we can unlock new possibilities and revolutionize industries with the transformative power of nanotechnology.
